'''AutomataNet''' was a publication covering [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It once published a study conducted by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] citing that [[A2 Accounting/Business Unit]]s were error prone when used by smaller corporations due to entering inconsistencies and errors into their accounting [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]].
